claims.text: Powell led the SCU analysis of the April 2013 Aguadilla, Puerto Rico thermal-imagery event recorded by a Department of Homeland Security aircraft.

SCU published '2013 Aguadilla Puerto Rico UAP: The detailed analysis of an Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon captured by the Department of Homeland Security' by Powell, Beall, Cates, Paulson and Hoffman.

edges.label: Co-author; brought the SCU case reconstructions
edges.note: Powell's FOIA-derived sensor reconstructions supplied the case inputs for the kinematic estimates.

edges.label: Founding board member; author of the Stephenville and Aguadilla studies
edges.note: Powell established SCU's method: obtain the primary federal sensor record by FOIA, reconstruct it quantitatively, deposit it with a DOI.

title: Powell, Beall, Cates, Paulson & Hoffman, '2013 Aguadilla Puerto Rico UAP', SCU (Zenodo)
